name: minimal-express-app
description: Minimal Express app with scalable structure

scripts.start: cross-env NODE_ENV=production HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT=${PORT:-3001} NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=2048 --heapsnapshot-near-heap-limit=3' node src/server.js
scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT=${PORT:-3001} NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=2048 --heapsnapshot-near-heap-limit=3' BROWSERSLIST_DISABLE_CACHE=1 node src/server.js
scripts.dev:watch: cross-env NODE_ENV=development HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT=${PORT:-3001} NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=2048 --heapsnapshot-near-heap-limit=3' nodemon --exitcrash src/server.js
scripts.preview: cross-env NODE_ENV=production HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT=${PORT:-3001} NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=2048 --heapsnapshot-near-heap-limit=3' node src/server.js
scripts.docs: echo 'Swagger UI at http://localhost:3001/api-docs (alias: /docs)' && node -e "console.log('OpenAPI JSON at /openapi.json')"
scripts.postinstall: echo 'Skipping browserslist update for backend' && npx --yes update-browserslist-db@latest --no-funding --no-update-notifier || true
